primary.title: SEBI's new ETF pricing rules from 7 September: What's changing and why investors should care — experts explain
primary.summary: SEBI’s new rules from 7 September will change base prices, price bands, pre-open auctions, and close-out procedures for ETFs. Here’s what the changes mean for investors, including how they may affect ETF trading, price discovery, and the way investors should trade.
